question:
Evaluate :

6 ÷ [5 - { 4 - (3 - {overline{2 - 1}} )}]
solution:
**Given:**

6 ÷ [5 - { 4 - (3 - (2 - 1))}]

**Formula used:**

Order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction

**Calculation:**

6 ÷ [5 - { 4 - (3 - (2 - 1))}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [5 - { 4 - (3 - 1)}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [5 - { 4 - 2}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [5 - 2]

⇒ 6 ÷ 3

⇒ 2

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
